say:1:1310224001:1.text: Everyone knows the festival originated from the war against the Hypogeans two thousand years ago.
say:1:1310224001:1.source_cn: 大家都知道，祭典源于两千年前与恶魔的战争。<key:d...

say:2:1310224002:1.text: In that war, alongside the heroes, countless soldiers laid down their lives. Many of them vanished without even a name to be remembered by...
say:2:1310224002:1.source_cn: 在那场战争中，除了英雄，还有数不清的战士也献出了生命，...

say:3:1310224003:1.text: So, we build snowmen with our own hands to honor those fearless soldiers who gave everything in the war.
say:3:1310224003:1.source_cn: 所以，我们用亲手堆起来的雪人来向那些在战争中奋不顾身的...

say:4:1310224004:1.text: Each snowman you create stands as the most loyal, pure, and courageous of warriors!
say:4:1310224004:1.source_cn: 你们堆的每一个雪人，都是最忠诚、最圣洁、最勇敢的战士！...
